intent: Open with exactly: "A store sold me a defective space heater." When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Midtown Appliance." California. January fifth, twenty twenty six. Once both are confirmed on the file, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call. The agent often says one moment or let me pull you up and then asks a question in the same turn. Always answer the question at the end of the agent's turn with the fact it asks for. Never reply with only "Sure", "Okay", "Yeah", or "Thank you" when the agent's turn ends in a question.
